title: Generic assembly template — replace with your actual circuit

steps.instruction: Identify the exact controller and connector using their labels.
steps.expected: Controller and connector labels are visible and match the build instructions.

steps.instruction: With power disconnected, seat the identified connector in the matching socket specified by your build instructions.
steps.expected: The specified connector is visibly seated in its matching labeled socket.

steps.instruction: Inspect the completed connection against the reference before the separate electrical test.
steps.expected: The visible assembly matches the verified reference without an unplugged connector.
